ov: فيلم أُصدر سنة 1983، من إخراج وودي آلن
plotEn:
During the Jazz Age of the 1920s, Leonard Zelig is a nondescript man who has the ability to transform his behavior and appearance to that of the people who surround him. He is first observed at a party by F. Scott Fitzgerald, who recounts that Zelig related to the affluent guests in a refined Boston accent and shared their Republican sympathies, but while in the kitchen with the servants, he adopted a coarser tone and claimed to be a Democrat. He is subsequently seen posing as a baseball player for the New York Yankees, a gangster, and a Black jazz trumpeter.
In 1928, after Zelig is reported missing by his landlady and his employer, the police find him in a Chinese establishment in Manhattan's Chinatown impersonating an Asian man and take him to a psychiatric hospital in a straitjacket. Upon arrival at the hospital, Zelig transforms back into Caucasian. When interviewed by psychiatrist Dr. Eudora Fletcher, Zelig claims to be a psychiatrist who has worked with Sigmund Freud. Fascinated with Zelig's case, Dr. Fletcher discovers through hypnosis that he yearns for approval so strongly that he physically changes to fit in with those around him. He soon gains national fame as the "human chameleon".
Zelig is suddenly removed from the hospital to be treated at home by his half-sister Ruth and her lover Martin Geist, a fraudulent businessman, who both exploit Zelig by turning him into a carnival attraction. He becomes the subject of a 1935 biographical film and several novelty songs,
